newsitem.title: UK: UK's Frogmore secures site for office park.
newsitem.headline: UK's Frogmore secures site for office park.

text.p: Britain's Frogmore Estates Plc said on Tuesday it secured a site in Chelmsford in southern England for a proposed office park that would have an end value of about 80 million stg.
Frogmore said a 1.0 million square-foot office park was planned for the 60-acre site next to Chelmsford's Boreham Interchange.
The company said it exchanged contracts to acquire 30 acres for 3.0 million stg and negotiated an option on the remainder of the site for a further 4.0 million stg.
Plans for the scheme will be submitted at the end of the month, and work on the first phase should commence by June, the company said in a statement.
Frogmore's shares rose 6.0p to 603.5p by 0950 GMT.
